Axiom International Investors Llc who had been investing in Bright Horizons Fam Sol In D for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $5.60 billion market cap company. (NYSE:BFAM) has risen 38.44% since April 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 26.89% the S&P500.
